title: merge-watch runtime hardening: live-owner guard + bound outer-loop await
description:
Runtime hardening do lifecycle do merge-watch no sidecar, pra que NENHUM orquestrador (cam-cli dev ou user via cam init) precise saber do contrato consume-on-read nem re-escrever o arquivo. Move comportamento de disciplina/memoria do orquestrador para runtime deterministico (filosofia de CAM-122/72/131). Absorve CAM-103.

DESCOBERTA (2026-06-29, batch autonomo): src/commands/sidecar.ts:299-300 faz eager-delete do .claude/.cam-merge-watch.json ANTES de iniciar runMergeWatch ("remove before starting to prevent re-entry on sidecar restart"). O watch vive so em memoria dentro de runMergeWatch (src/release/merge-watch.ts), polling ate 240x60s (4h). Tres problemas:
(1) DOUBLE-WATCHER: se o arquivo for (re)escrito enquanto um watch in-memory ja roda, o proximo idle tick le e spawna um 2o watcher -> dois post-merge no mesmo PR (observado 3x: "tag created" + "tag existed"). Eager-delete nao protege contra isso, so contra restart.
(2) CRASH-LOSS: se o sidecar morrer DEPOIS de consumir o arquivo (ja deletado), o sidecar reiniciado nao recupera o watch -> post-merge nunca roda, operador tem que intervir.
(3) (CAM-103) o await runMergeWatch BLOQUEIA o outer loop do sidecar ate 4h sem health-check.

ESCOPO (a grelhar):
- Trocar eager-delete-on-read por GUARD DE DONO-VIVO (pid + heartbeat/timestamp no arquivo ou lock irmao): re-entry/duplicate-write NAO spawna 2o watcher se ha dono vivo (mata double post-merge na raiz, independe de disciplina); dono morto (pid/heartbeat stale) -> sidecar reiniciado RETOMA o watch (mata crash-loss); remover o arquivo so no terminal (merged/closed/ci-red/timeout).
- (CAM-103) bound/interleave/health-check o await pra nao bloquear o outer loop.
- Secundario: linha no cam-ship.md shipado documentando o contrato (consume by-design, nao re-escrever); runtime robusto torna dispensavel.

ARQUIVOS: src/commands/sidecar.ts (closure merge-watch ~278-330, eager-delete 299-300), src/release/merge-watch.ts (runMergeWatch, MergeWatchState/options), src/supervisor (outer loop, item CAM-103), + testes real-bun (restart-resume, no-double-watcher). Absorve/supersede CAM-103.
